headline: A Stranger's $15,000 Gift Unlocks a Mozart-Level Pianist
meta_description: A Colorado piano tuner gave a grand piano to an autistic boy after hearing about his extraordinary talent, transforming his life from discovery to touring musi…
summary_short: Bill Magnuson spent part of his family inheritance to give Jude Kofie, a 9-year-old autistic pianist from Aurora, Colorado, a $15,000 grand piano—launching a musical car…
body:
When Jude Kofie discovered an old electric keyboard in his family's basement five years ago, a hidden gift emerged. The autistic boy from Aurora, Colorado, sat at the keys and revealed what piano tuner Bill Magnuson would later describe as "Mozart level" talent—a prodigious ability that seemed to come from nowhere. What began as a local news story about an immigrant father raising four children caught Magnuson's attention, prompting him to attend one of Jude's talent shows. One glimpse was enough to change everything.

Magnuson, moved by both the boy's extraordinary gift and his father Isiah's quiet dedication—regularly sending remittances to family in Ghana while raising his children alone—made an extraordinary decision. Without warning, he arranged for a truck to deliver a brand new grand piano to the Kofie household, a $15,000 investment drawn from his family inheritance. Along with the instrument came a lifetime of tuning services and a program of professional lessons.

Today, Jude is no longer the nine-year-old prodigy. Now fourteen, he has become a touring musician with his own album, *Introducing: Jude Kofie*. The transformation would never have happened without Magnuson's intervention—an act of generosity that turned a complete stranger into a permanent part of the family's story. As Isiah said, tears streaming down his face: the gift secured his son's future in a way that no amount of struggle alone could have achieved.
quick_facts: Bill Magnuson, piano tuner, gave $15,000 grand piano to boy
Jude Kofie discovered talent on basement keyboard at age 9
Aurora, Colorado boy now touring at age 14 with own album
Father Isiah raises four children and sends remittances to Ghana
